defs.def: easy to understand and not causing any confusion 清晰易懂的；明白清楚的；不含混的

ex.s: Became very clear to me.
ex.t: 对我来说变得非常清楚。

ex.s: It suddenly became very clear to me how lucky I was to be fluent in two languages.
ex.t: 我突然非常清楚地意识到我能流利地说两种语言是多么幸运。

ex.s: This makes it clear to the other person that you are giving them a choice.
ex.t: 这向对方清楚地表明，您正在给他们一个选择。

ex.s: They also have a clearer estimation of what they know and don’t know.
ex.t: 它们也对自己知道和不知道什么有更清晰的估计。

ex.s: At this point, it is not clear why dogs seem to be equipped with the ability to recognize different facial expressions in humans.
ex.t: 在这一点上，还不清楚为什么狗似乎天生具备识别人类不同面部表情的能力。

ex.s: Once you are clear about your reason, tell your family or roommates about the change you want to make.
ex.t: 一旦你清楚了自己的理由，就告诉家人或室友你想做的改变。

ex.s: It clearly showed that while likability can lead to healthy adjustment, high status has just the opposite effect on us."
ex.t: 结果清楚地表明，虽然讨人喜欢可以促进健康的适应，但高地位对我们却有完全相反的效果。"

ex.s: It helps clearly convey meaning and also creates a natural rhythm to the sentence.
ex.t: 它有助于清楚地传达含义，也为句子创造了一种自然的节奏。

ex.s: The performance borrowed a lot from Chinese dance and music, so the Eastern influence on the ballet was clear.
ex.t: 这部作品大量借鉴了中国舞蹈和音乐，因此东方对这部芭蕾舞剧的影响清晰可见。

ex.s: Being clear and brief — while maintaining interest and including everything your listeners need to know — is a high-level communication skill.
ex.t: 做到清晰简洁——同时维持吸引力并包含听众需要知道的一切——是一项高阶的沟通技巧。

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 特纳明智地说，“从心理上讲”“做得好”是能够顺应情绪的流动，管理情绪，与他人清晰良好地沟通，并掌握各种技能。“

ex.s: “Good morning,” the voice said calmly, clearly  24  at me.
ex.t: "早上好，"那个声音平静而清晰地说，显然24 对着我说的。

ex.s: As it became clearer that fashion was what I wanted to do full time, the reality of my day-to-day work at the insurance company became harder.
ex.t: 随着情况越来越清楚时尚是我想要全职从事的现实中日复一日在保险公司的工作变得越来越难熬。

defs.def: obvious and leaving no doubt at all 明显的；显然的；明确的

ex.s: Is there a clear advantage of one style over the other?
ex.t: 一种风格相对于另一种有明显优势吗？

ex.s: In other words, there are clear advantages for each.
ex.t: 换言之，对各方都有明显优势。

ex.s: The invitation is clear: Weiner wants you to pick up a coffee or tea and sit down with this book.
ex.t: 邀请函很明确： Weiner希望您拿起一杯咖啡或茶，坐下来阅读这本书。

ex.s: Let's state clearly: Einstein was a genius.
ex.t: 我们明确地说：爱因斯坦是个天才。

ex.s: One day, while driving near her home, she saw a dog wandering on the road, clearly lost.
ex.t: 一天，在她家附近开车时，她看到一只狗在路上游荡，显然迷路了。

ex.s: The most hopeful data shared in the report shows clear evidence of parents serving as examples and important guides for their kids when it comes to reading.
ex.t: 报告中分享的最有希望的数据表明，有明确证据表明，在阅读方面，父母为子女树立了榜样和重要的指南。

ex.s: But when Dennis Williams    42    a text that clearly wasn’t intended for him, he did something    43   .
ex.t: 但当丹尼斯·威廉姆斯___42___一条显然不是发给他的短信时，他做了件___43___的事。

ex.s: His reply came as a surprise — a shock, actually: “Not a chance.” Clearly, he was unhappy over the way we had parted.
ex.t: 他的回复令人意外——其实是震惊：“绝不可能。”显然，他对我们分开时的方式感到不快。

ex.s: Clearly, my way of reading the text had shifted, and I myself had changed over the years.
ex.t: 显然，我阅读文本的方式已经改变，而这些年来我自己也变了。

defs.def: having or feeling no doubt or confusion 无疑的；清楚的；明白的

ex.s: The clearest example of this between literate and non-literate history is perhaps the first conflict, at Botany Bay, between Captain Cook’s voyage and the Australian Aboriginals.
ex.t: 在有文字和无文字历史之间，最清楚的例子也许是库克船长的航行与澳大利亚原住民在植物湾发生的第一次冲突。

defs.def: thinking in a sensible and logical way, especially in a difficult situation （尤指在困境中）思维敏锐而有逻辑的，头脑清醒的

ex.s: You can keep your head clear for 4-10 hours after exercise.
ex.t: 运动后你可以保持头脑清醒4到10小时。

defs.def: easy to see or hear 容易看见的；听得清的

ex.s: The ground floor of the forest is not all tangled leaves and bushes, like in films, but is actually fairly clear.
ex.t: 森林的地面并不像电影里那样全是纠缠不清的树叶和灌木，而是实际上相当开阔。

ex.s: A dirty stream, for example, often became clear after flowing through plants and along rocks where tiny creatures lived.
ex.t: 例如，一条污浊的小溪在流经植物和栖息着微小生物的岩石后，常常变得清澈。

defs.def: that you can see through 透明的；清澈的

ex.s: The clear front of the box had a “keyhole” in a geometric shape, and the birds were given five differently shaped “keys” to choose from.
ex.t: 盒子透明的正面有一个几何形状的“钥匙孔”，鸟儿们会得到五个形状各异的“钥匙”供选择。

ex.s: First, he constructed a series of clear fiberglass tanks connected to each other.
ex.t: 首先，他建造了一系列相互连接的透明玻璃纤维水箱。

defs.def: without cloud or mist 无云（或雾）的；晴朗的

ex.s: The state also cleared the way for companies to sell or rent out self-driving cars, and for companies to operate driverless taxi services.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在应该开始思考如何确保自动驾驶汽车的出现不会延续我们当前受控于汽车的交通系统中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: They may clear up other people’s mess.
ex.t: 他们可能会清理别人的烂摊子。

ex.s: Dear Friends, We are writing this letter to call on everyone to take part in the Clear Your Plate campaign.
ex.t: 亲爱的朋友们，我们写这封信是为了呼吁所有人参加Clear Your Plate活动。

ex.s: The day was cold but clear: tourists and Londoners stopped to watch the skaters.
ex.t: 那天天气寒冷但晴朗：游客和伦敦人停下来观看滑板者。

defs.def: without spots or marks 无斑（或疤痕）的
bright and lively 明亮有神的
free from things that are blocking the way or covering the surface of sth 畅通无阻的；无障碍的；（表面）收拾干净的
if you have a clear conscience or your conscience is clear, you do not feel guilty 无罪的；清白的；问心无愧的

ex.s: They clear the atmosphere.
ex.t: 它们以圆形方式传播。

defs.def: free from sth that is unpleasant 摆脱掉（不愉快事物）的
not touching sth; a distance away from sth 不接触；远离
whole or complete 全部的；整体的；完整的
remaining when taxes, costs, etc. have been taken away （扣除税项、成本等后）净的，纯的
produced with the central part of the tongue close to the top of the mouth. In many accents of English, clear /l/ is used before a vowel, as in leave. 语音
to remove sth that is not wanted or needed from a place 移走，搬走，清除（不需要的东西）

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 不过唯一需要的部件是一张5×5英尺的透明或微乳白塑料布、六英尺塑料管，以及一个容器——或许就一个喝水杯——来接水。

defs.def: to make people leave a place 使人离开
to move freely again; to no longer be blocked 恢复畅通；不再受阻
when a liquid clears, it becomes transparent and you can see through it 变透明；变清澈
when smoke, fog, etc. clears, it disappears so that it is easier to see things （烟、雾等）消散，散去，消失
when the sky or the weather clears, it becomes brighter and free of cloud or rain 变明朗；转晴；放晴

ex.s: The outcome is still far from clear.
ex.t: 结果还远未明朗。

defs.def: if your head or mind clears, or you clear it, you become free of thoughts that worry or confuse you or the effects of alcohol, a blow, etc. and you are able to think clearly （使）变清醒，变清晰

ex.s: as clear as day B. off the top of my head
ex.t: 一清二楚  B. 不假思索

ex.s: It may be a quick and, to you, clear way to communicate, but before you use it.
ex.t: 这对你来说可能是一种快捷且清晰的交流方式，但在使用之前要三思。

ex.s: The man thinks Professor Smith explained the physics problem very clearly.
ex.t: 你会被问到几个问题，文章和对话将读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

defs.def: if your face or expression clears, you stop looking angry or worried 变平静；变开朗
to prove that sb is innocent 证明无罪（或无辜）
to give or get official approval for sth to be done 批准；准许；得到许可
to give official permission for a person, a ship, a plane or goods to leave or enter a place 批准（人、船只、飞机或货物）离境（或入境）；使通过（海关）
to decide officially, after finding out information about sb, that they can be given special work or allowed to see secret papers （经审查后）正式批准（某人）做机密工作（或阅读机密文件）
if a cheque that you pay into your bank account clears, or a bank clears it, the money is available for you to use 兑现（支票）
to gain or earn a sum of money as profit 获利；净赚
if you clear a debt or a loan, you pay all the money back 偿清，还清（债务或贷款）
to jump over or get past sth without touching it （无接触地）跃过，越过，通过
if you clear a ball, or a ball clears, it is kicked or hit away from the area near your own goal 足球及其他一些体育运动
to become fine or bright 天气
to disappear 疾病、感染等
away from sth; not near or touching sth 远离；不靠近；不接触
all the way to sth that is far away 一直（到远处）
